ZEPHYR_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install zephyr. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

ZEPHYR_VERSION.description: Specific version of zephyr to install.

ZEPHYR_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading zephyr binary or archive artifacts.

ZEPHYR_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying zephyr available remote releases.

ZEPHYR_BOARD.description: Target Zephyr board identifier (qemu_x86_64, qemu_cortex_a53, qemu_cortex_m3, qemu_riscv32, qemu_riscv64, native_sim, native_sim_64).

ZEPHYR_KCONFIG_FRAGMENTS.description: Comma-separated Kconfig fragment filenames or paths merged into prj.conf/.config.

ZEPHYR_DTS_OVERLAYS.description: Comma-separated Devicetree .overlay paths merged during firmware synthesis.

ZEPHYR_TOOLCHAIN_VARIANT.description: Zephyr CMake toolchain variant (zephyr, llvm, gnuarmemb, cross-compile, host).

ZEPHYR_COMPILER.description: LibScript compiler backend selector (default, gcc, clang, edgcpp, custom-cc).

ZEPHYR_USE_WEST.description: When set to 1, invokes west build instead of direct rootless CMake + Ninja.

ZEPHYR_COMPARE_COMPILERS.description: Space- or comma-separated list of compilers evaluated by compare_compilers.{sh,cmd}.

ZEPHYR_BASE.description: Root path of the active Zephyr RTOS source tree exported by env.{sh,cmd}.

ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR.description: Isolated Zephyr SDK directory path exported to CMake.

ZEPHYR_FETCH_FULL_SOURCE.description: When set to 1, downloads and extracts the full upstream Zephyr source tarball during install.
